PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?cap ?label
WHERE {
  ?org sdk:hasProcessCapability ?cap .
  ?cap rdfs:label ?label .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?label)), "machining"))
}

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?cap ?label
WHERE {
  ?org sdk:hasMaterialCapability ?cap .
  ?cap rdfs:label ?label .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?label)), "steel"))
}

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-scro: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/supplychain/SupplyChain/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?zipValue
WHERE {
  ?site sdk:hasPostalAddress ?addr .
  ?addr iof-scro:hasTextValue ?addrText .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?addrText)), "suite")) .
  ?site sdk:hasZIPcode ?zip .
  ?zip sdk:hasIntegerValue ?zipValue .
}

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?state ?stateLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?manufacturer) AS ?manufacturerCount)
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state a sdk:State .
  OPTIONAL { ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel . }
}
GROUP BY ?state ?stateLabel
ORDER BY ?stateLabel

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?state ?stateLabel (AVG(?numVal) AS ?avgEmployees)
WHERE {
  ?org a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
       sdk:hasNumberOfEmployees ?num ;
       sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  OPTIONAL { ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel . }
  BIND(REPLACE(STR(?num), ",", "") AS ?numstr)
  BIND(xsd:decimal(?numstr) AS ?numVal)
}
GROUP BY ?state ?stateLabel
ORDER BY ?stateLabel

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?manufacturer ?label ?employeeCount
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                rdfs:label ?label ;
                sdk:hasNumberOfEmployees ?empLit .
  BIND(REPLACE(STR(?empLit), ",", "") AS ?empStr)
  BIND(xsd:integer(?empStr) AS ?employeeCount)
  FILTER(?employeeCount > 500)
}
ORDER BY ?label

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?state ?stateLabel (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?manufacturerLabel; separator=", ") AS ?manufacturers)
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                rdfs:label ?manufacturerLabel ;
                sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
  FILTER regex(?stateLabel, "^New ")
}
GROUP BY ?state ?stateLabel
ORDER BY ?stateLabel

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?manufacturer ?manufacturerLabel ?employeeCount
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                sdk:hasNumberOfEmployees ?empLit .
  OPTIONAL { ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?manufacturerLabel }
  BIND(STR(?empLit) AS ?empStr)
  BIND(REPLACE(?empStr, "[^0-9\\-]", "") AS ?empDigits)
  BIND(xsd:integer(?empDigits) AS ?employeeCount)
  FILTER(BOUND(?employeeCount))
}
ORDER BY DESC(?employeeCount)
LIMIT 1

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?manufacturer ?manufacturerLabel ?employeeCount
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site ;
                sdk:hasNumberOfEmployees ?emp .
  OPTIONAL { ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?manufacturerLabel . }
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?stateLabel)), "ohio")) .
  BIND(REPLACE(STR(?emp), "[^0-9]", "") AS ?empDigits) .
  BIND(xsd:integer(?empDigits) AS ?employeeCount) .
}
ORDER BY ASC(?employeeCount)
LIMIT 1

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?state ?stateLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?org) AS ?manufacturerCount)
WHERE {
  ?org a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
       sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  OPTIONAL { ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel . }
}
GROUP BY ?state ?stateLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?manufacturerCount)
LIMIT 1

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?manufacturer ?manufacturerLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?combo) AS ?combinedCapabilityCount)
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  ?manufacturer sdk:hasProcessCapability ?proc .
  ?manufacturer sdk:hasMaterialCapability ?mat .
  BIND(CONCAT(STR(?proc), "||", STR(?mat)) AS ?combo)
  OPTIONAL { ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?manufacturerLabel }
}
GROUP BY ?manufacturer ?manufacturerLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?combinedCapabilityCount)
LIMIT 1

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?manufacturer ?manufacturerLabel ?latitude
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:hasSpatialCoordinates ?coord .
  ?coord sdk:hasLatitudeValue ?latRaw .
  BIND(xsd:float(?latRaw) AS ?latitude)
  OPTIONAL { ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?manufacturerLabel . }
}
ORDER BY DESC(?latitude)
LIMIT 1

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?state ?stateLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?m) AS ?manufacturerCount)
WHERE {
  ?m a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
     sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state a sdk:State .
  OPTIONAL { ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel }
}
GROUP BY ?state ?stateLabel
ORDER BY ?stateLabel

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?state ?stateLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?org) AS ?manufacturerCount)
WHERE {
  ?org a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
       sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state a sdk:State .
  OPTIONAL { ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel . }
}
GROUP BY ?state ?stateLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?manufacturerCount)
LIMIT 1

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?employeeBucket (COUNT(DISTINCT ?org) AS ?companyCount)
WHERE {
  ?org a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
       sdk:hasNumberOfEmployees ?empLit .
  BIND(xsd:integer(REPLACE(STR(?empLit), ",", "")) AS ?emp)
  FILTER(?emp > 250)
  BIND(FLOOR((?emp - 1) / 250) AS ?idx)
  BIND((?idx * 250) + 1 AS ?startEmp)
  BIND((?idx + 1) * 250 AS ?endEmp)
  BIND(CONCAT(STR(?startEmp), "-", STR(?endEmp)) AS ?employeeBucket)
}
GROUP BY ?employeeBucket

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?manufacturer ?manufacturerLabel
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                sdk:hasProcessCapability ?cap .
  ?cap a ?capType .
  VALUES ?capType {
    sdk:CastingCapability
    sdk:SandCastingCapability
    sdk:DieCastingCapability
    sdk:GravityCastingCapability
    sdk:PermanentMoldCastingCapability
    sdk:CeramicMoldCastingCapability
    sdk:InvestmentCastingCapability
    sdk:MachiningOfCastingCapability
    sdk:SqueezeCastingCapability
    sdk:HotChamberDieCastingCapability
  }
  OPTIONAL { ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?manufacturerLabel }
}

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?manufacturer ?manufacturerLabel ?capability ?capabilityType
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                sdk:hasProcessCapability ?capability .
  ?capability a ?capabilityType .
  FILTER(?capabilityType IN (
    sdk:FormingCapability,
    sdk:ForgingCapability,
    sdk:RollForgingCapability,
    sdk:RollingCapability,
    sdk:PowderMetalFormingCapability
  ))
  OPTIONAL { ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?manufacturerLabel . }
}
ORDER BY ?manufacturerLabel ?manufacturer ?capabilityType ?capability

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?manufacturer ?manufacturerLabel
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  OPTIONAL { ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?manufacturerLabel . }

  ?manufacturer sdk:suppliesToIndustry ?indMD .
  ?indMD rdfs:label ?mdLabel .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?mdLabel)) = "medical devices") .

  ?manufacturer sdk:suppliesToIndustry ?indPh .
  ?indPh rdfs:label ?phLabel .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?phLabel)) = "pharmaceuticals") .
}
ORDER BY ?manufacturerLabel ?manufacturer

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?manufacturer ?manufacturerLabel
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  ?manufacturer sdk:hasMaterialCapability ?steelCap .
  ?steelCap a sdk:SteelProcessingCapability .
  ?manufacturer sdk:hasMaterialCapability ?bronzeCap .
  ?bronzeCap a sdk:BronzeProcessingCapability .
  OPTIONAL { ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?manufacturerLabel . }
}

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?manufacturer ?manufacturerLabel ?stateLabel ?employeeCount
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site ;
                sdk:hasNumberOfEmployees ?employeeCount ;
                sdk:hasProcessCapability ?cap .
  OPTIONAL { ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?manufacturerLabel . }
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
  FILTER(?stateLabel = "Arizona") .
  ?cap a ?capClass .
  ?capClass rdfs:subClassOf* sdk:AdditiveManufacturingCapability .
  BIND(REPLACE(STR(?employeeCount), ",", "") AS ?empNoCommas) .
  BIND(xsd:integer(?empNoCommas) AS ?empVal) .
  FILTER(?empVal > 50)
}

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?manufacturer ?label ?employeeCount
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                sdk:hasNumberOfEmployees ?employeesRaw .
  OPTIONAL { ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?label . }
  BIND(REPLACE(STR(?employeesRaw), ",", "") AS ?empLex)
  BIND(xsd:integer(?empLex) AS ?employeeCount)
  FILTER(?employeeCount >= 100)
}
ORDER BY ?manufacturer

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX iof-scro: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/supplychain/SupplyChain/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX bfo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?manufacturer ?manufacturerLabel ?zipVal ?lat
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                rdfs:label ?manufacturerLabel ;
                sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city ;
        sdk:hasZIPcode ?zip ;
        sdk:hasSpatialCoordinates ?coords .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
  FILTER(STR(?stateLabel) = "Arizona") .
  ?zip sdk:hasIntegerValue ?zipVal .
  FILTER(STR(?zipVal) != "85001") .
  ?coords sdk:hasLatitudeValue ?lat .
  FILTER(?lat > "33.4"^^xsd:float) .
}
